correctness.rationale: PASS: From the actual canonical Hansen vertex set ±(χ_S,1) and the Freij–Henze–Schmitt–Ziegler perfect-graph facet system |2x(C)−t|≤1 (including C empty), each signed facet normal (2·1_C,−1) has norm sqrt(4|C|+1). A radius-r ball at center c must satisfy |⟨a_C,c⟩|+r||a_C||≤1; maximum clique forces r≤1/sqrt(4ω+1), and the origin-centered ball of this radius satisfies all facets. Its tangent facets are precisely both signed facets indexed by maximum cliques. Every extreme point ±(χ_S,1) has Euclidean norm sqrt(|S|+1); a maximum stable S gives an antipodal diameter, forcing enclosing radius sqrt(α+1), achieved at 0. Average squared distances to the antipodal pair show a same-radius enclosing ball has center 0 uniquely. This is dimension-free conditional on the fully cited exact facet theorem, not extrapolation from small graphs. The origin is an incenter; uniqueness of incenter is not claimed.
